description: Subcommittee plans public art discussions and mentorship for artists.
Initial budget of $6,000 for workshops and artist fees.
Aims to increase awareness and support emerging artists.

chips.text: Committee debated including blank evaluation forms in minutes for transparency.
Emerging artists will receive mentorship and support for public art projects.
Is there a universal evaluation matrix for public art projects?
Detailed plan for public art events will be developed before summer.

segments.title: Public Education Subcommittee Proposal
segments.takeaway: The Public Education Subcommittee proposed a series of public art discussions and a mentorship workshop program, with an initial budget of $1,500 for the first event.

segments.title: Discussion on Public Education Proposal
segments.takeaway: Committee members discussed the Public Education Subcommittee's proposal, clarifying its integration into the overall work plan and timeline for developing detailed event plans.

segments.title: Professional Development Committee Proposal
segments.takeaway: The Professional Development Committee proposed enhancing member value and transparency in public art adjudication, suggesting inviting artists and reviewing past decision-making processes.

segments.title: Discussion on Evaluation Rubric Transparency
segments.takeaway: The committee discussed the transparency of the public art evaluation rubric, exploring whether artists receive feedback and if a standardized matrix should be publicly accessible.

segments.title: Acceptance of Subcommittee Proposals
segments.takeaway: The committee formally accepted the proposals from both the Public Education and Professional Development subcommittees, agreeing to flesh out the details and incorporate them into the work plan.

segments.title: Riversdale Chinatown Project Update

segments.title: Discussion on Riversdale Chinatown Project
segments.takeaway: Committee members questioned the Riversdale Chinatown project's engagement strategies with older community members and indigenous artists, emphasizing the need for inclusive and iterative approaches.

segments.title: Finalizing the Overall Work Plan
segments.takeaway: The committee moved to finalize the overall work plan by incorporating the accepted subcommittee proposals and submitting a summary document to the Standing Policy Committee for approval.
